about: Contract of engine.js/engine.wasm with its host (@browser-lite/core). Checked against engine/src, engine/js and engine/patches by tests/contract/abi-test.mjs. Strings passed into exports are UTF-8 allocated with malloc (stringToNewUTF8); the engine frees them. An empty env value counts as unset (the default applies) unless its doc says otherwise. Exports are callable from any thread and do their work asynchronously on the engine thread unless 'thread' says otherwise. View ids are chosen by the host (from 1); views the engine opens itself (window.open) get ids from 2^20 and are announced with the event 'newview'.

exports.name: bl_destroy_view

exports.name: bl_try_close

exports.name: bl_load_html

exports.name: bl_restore_history
exports.doc: Puts back the history {"entries":[{"url","title"}],"index":n} and loads the current entry.

exports.name: bl_go_back
exports.doc: History back.

exports.name: bl_go_forward
exports.doc: History forward.

exports.name: bl_reload
exports.doc: Reloads (asks beforeunload with dialog type 4).

exports.name: bl_stop
exports.doc: Stops loading.

exports.name: bl_resize
exports.args: int id, int width, int height, float deviceScaleFactor
exports.doc: New view size in CSS pixels and device pixel ratio.

exports.name: bl_frame
exports.doc: Once per requestAnimationFrame after onEngineNeedsFrame: rendering update and paint.

exports.name: bl_frame_presented
exports.doc: The host copied the frame of onEngineFrame, the pixel buffer may be painted again.

exports.name: bl_view_source
exports.doc: Loads the source of the current page, arrives as a download flagged viewSource.

exports.name: bl_eval_script
exports.doc: Runs JS in the main frame, prints '[eval id] result' to the console. Only with BL_TEST_HOOKS=1.

exports.name: bl_mouse

exports.doc: Mouse button. type 0 down, 1 up, 2 move; button like MouseEvent.button; modifiers bit 1 shift, 2 ctrl, 4 alt, 8 meta, 16 caps lock.

exports.name: bl_mouse_move
exports.args: int id, double x, double y, double movementX, double movementY, int button, int modifiers
exports.doc: Mouse move with movementX/Y (pointer lock); button -1 = none pressed.

exports.name: bl_drag
exports.args: int id, int phase, double x, double y, int modifiers, char* data
exports.doc: Drag from the host: phase 0 over, 1 left, 2 dropped; data JSON {text, html, uriList, files, fileCount}.

exports.name: bl_pointer_lock
exports.doc: Answer of the host to the event 'pointerlock'.

exports.name: bl_wheel
exports.args: int id, double x, double y, double deltaX, double deltaY, int modifiers
exports.thread: Goes directly to the scrolling thread when compositing, so pages scroll while the engine thread is busy.
exports.doc: Wheel with DOM deltas (pixels).

exports.name: bl_zoom_wheel
exports.args: int id, double x, double y, double deltaX, double deltaY, int modifiers, int cancelable
exports.doc: Ctrl + wheel to the page. Returns 1 when the page may call preventDefault (answer in 'wheel-result'), 0 when the host should zoom right away.

exports.name: bl_key
exports.args: int id, int type, char* key, char* code, char* text, int keyCode, int repeat, int modifiers
exports.doc: Key event: type 0 down, 1 up; modifiers like bl_mouse.

exports.name: bl_set_composition
exports.args: int id, char* text, int selectionStart, int selectionEnd
exports.doc: IME preview (compositionupdate).

exports.name: bl_confirm_composition
exports.doc: IME completion (compositionend).

exports.name: bl_insert_text
exports.doc: Inserts finished text (on-screen keyboard, dead keys).

exports.name: bl_choose_files
exports.doc: Answer to 'filechooser': engine file system paths separated by newlines, empty = cancelled.

exports.name: bl_popup_choose
exports.doc: Answer to 'popup': item index, -1 = cancelled.

exports.name: bl_color_chosen
exports.args: int id, char* color, int done
exports.doc: Answer to 'colorpicker': "#rrggbb", done 1 closes the chooser.

exports.name: bl_datetime_chosen
exports.args: int id, char* value, int done
exports.doc: Answer to 'datetimepicker': input value, empty = cancelled.

exports.name: bl_focus_initial
exports.doc: Tab from outside into the page: focus the first (1) or last (0) element.

exports.name: bl_set_zoom
exports.doc: Page zoom (like Ctrl +/-).

exports.name: bl_pinch
exports.args: int id, int phase, double factor, double x, double y
exports.thread: Goes to the compositor directly when compositing.
exports.doc: Pinch zoom: phase 0 begin, 1 step (factor relative to the last), 2 end, 3 cancel; x/y focus point.

exports.name: bl_find
exports.args: int id, char* text, int backwards, int again
exports.doc: Find in page, answer 'find'.

exports.name: bl_find_done
exports.doc: Ends find and removes the marks.

exports.name: bl_set_muted
exports.doc: Mutes the view.

exports.name: bl_print
exports.doc: Prints the main frame to PDF, result through onEnginePrint.

exports.name: bl_context_menu
exports.args: int id, double x, double y
exports.doc: Right click: page contextmenu event first, then 'contextmenu' unless the page handled it.

exports.name: bl_command
exports.doc: Editor command (Copy, Cut, Paste, SelectAll, Undo, Redo, ...).

exports.name: bl_media_event
exports.doc: State of the host <video> of a player (answer to onEngineMedia commands).

exports.name: bl_media_frame
exports.args: int playerId, uint8_t* pixels, int width, int height
exports.doc: New RGBA frame of a host <video> (malloc, the engine takes it over).

exports.name: bl_media_fetch
exports.args: int playerId, int fetchId, double start, double end
exports.doc: The media service worker asks for bytes [start, end) of a player's file, results through onEngineMediaFetch.

exports.name: bl_media_fetch_cancel
exports.doc: Cancels a media fetch.

exports.name: bl_exit_fullscreen
exports.doc: The host left fullscreen (Esc) or could not enter it.

exports.name: bl_focus
exports.doc: Keyboard focus of the view.

exports.name: bl_set_visible
exports.doc: Visible or hidden (no painting, timers throttled).

exports.name: bl_set_screen
exports.args: int width, int height, int availableWidth, int availableHeight, int flags
exports.doc: Screen in CSS pixels; flags 1 dark color scheme, 2 touch screen, 4 mobile (coarse pointer without hover).

exports.name: bl_touch
exports.args: int id, int type, char* points, int modifiers
exports.doc: Touch: type 0 start, 1 move, 2 end, 3 cancel; points JSON [{id, x, y, state, rx, ry, force}]. Answer 'touch-result'.

exports.name: bl_permission_answer
exports.doc: Answer to 'permission': 1 granted, 2 denied, 0 closed without decision.

exports.name: bl_set_permission
exports.args: char* kind, char* origin, int decision
exports.doc: Stored decision (PermissionStore of the host): 0 ask, 1 granted, 2 denied.

exports.name: bl_geolocation_position
exports.args: int id, double latitude, double longitude, double accuracy, double altitude, double altitudeAccuracy, double heading, double speed, double timestamp
exports.doc: Position after 'geolocation-start' (NaN = value missing).

exports.name: bl_geolocation_error
exports.args: int id, int code, char* message
exports.doc: Geolocation error: code 1 denied, otherwise unavailable.

exports.name: bl_device_orientation
exports.args: int id, double alpha, double beta, double gamma, int absolute
exports.doc: deviceorientation of the host after 'sensor-start' (NaN = missing).

exports.name: bl_device_motion
exports.args: int id, double x, double y, double z, double gravityX, double gravityY, double gravityZ, double rotationAlpha, double rotationBeta, double rotationGamma, double interval
exports.doc: devicemotion of the host after 'sensor-start' (NaN = missing).

exports.name: bl_host_call_result
exports.args: double identifier, int ok, char* result
exports.doc: Answer to 'host-call': ok 1 resolves with the JSON result, 0 rejects with {name, message}.

exports.name: bl_notification_event
exports.doc: Notification shown (0), clicked (1), closed (2) or failed (3).

exports.name: bl_gamepad
exports.doc: Gamepad state {connected, id, mapping, axes, buttons, haptics} while 'gamepad-monitor' is on.

exports.name: bl_speech_voices
exports.doc: Voices of the host [{uri, name, lang, local, default}].

exports.name: bl_speech_event
exports.args: double id, int type, int charIndex, int charLength
exports.doc: Progress of an utterance from 'speak': 0 start, 1 end, 2 pause, 3 resume, 4 error, 5 word, 6 sentence.

exports.name: bl_speech_recognition_event
exports.args: double id, int type, char* json
exports.doc: Speech recognition events (0 start, 1-6 audio/sound/speech start and end, 7 result, 8 no match, 9 error, 10 end).

exports.name: bl_set_user_agent
exports.doc: User agent and navigator.platform, empty = default. Before the first view.

exports.name: bl_set_languages
exports.doc: Comma list for navigator.languages, Accept-Language and Intl, empty = en-US.

exports.name: bl_set_preferences
exports.doc: For all views: 1 JavaScript off, 2 images off, 4 Global Privacy Control.

exports.name: bl_set_online
exports.doc: navigator.onLine and online/offline events (host network and transport.connected).

exports.name: bl_set_clipboard_text
exports.doc: Puts text on the engine clipboard.

exports.name: bl_set_clipboard
exports.doc: Paste from the host: {"text","html","files":[engine paths]}.

exports.name: bl_remove_path
exports.doc: Deletes a file or folder of the engine file system (uploads of a closed view).

exports.name: bl_storage_flush
exports.thread: waitMilliseconds > 0 blocks the caller up to that long (page hide).
exports.doc: Writes pending databases to /data now.

exports.name: bl_input_mark
exports.doc: Watchdog: the engine thread stores the mark after the input before it.

exports.name: bl_input_mark_address
exports.doc: Address of the stored input mark (uint32 in shared memory) the host reads to detect a hanging engine thread.

exports.name: bl_memory_used
exports.doc: Allocated malloc bytes.

exports.name: bl_memory_report

exports.name: bl_crash_for_testing

exports.name: bl_webgl_lose_context_for_testing

exports.name: bl_gpu_lose_context_for_testing

exports.name: bl_gpu_restore_context_for_testing
exports.doc: Restores the context lost by bl_gpu_lose_context_for_testing.

exports.name: bl_capture_failed
exports.doc: Capture of 'capture-start' was denied or broke.

exports.name: bl_capture_ended
exports.doc: Capture of 'capture-start' ended (user stopped sharing).

exports.name: bl_remote_muted
exports.doc: Remote WebRTC track muted (no packets) or back.

internalExports.name: bl__write_file

internalExports.name: bl__storage_namespace

internalExports.name: bl__socket_closed

internalExports.name: bl__http_cache_result

internalExports.name: bl__bytecode_cache_result
internalExports.doc: Answer of a bytecode cache lookup.

internalExports.name: bl__codec_video_config
internalExports.doc: Decoder config of a video encoder.

internalExports.name: bl__codec_audio_config

internalExports.name: bl__wasm_release_guest

internalExports.name: bl__compositor_frame

moduleHooks.name: blTransport
moduleHooks.doc: openTCP(host, port) -> stream {send, close, onopen, ondata, onsent, onclose(reason)}; reason is one of closeReasons.

moduleHooks.name: locateFile
moduleHooks.doc: Emscripten: URL of engine.wasm, engine.data and the worker script.

moduleHooks.name: preRun
moduleHooks.doc: Emscripten: sets Module.ENV (see env) and adds run dependencies before main().

moduleHooks.name: print
moduleHooks.doc: Emscripten stdout (console messages of the engine, [eval], [memory]).

moduleHooks.name: printErr
moduleHooks.doc: Emscripten stderr ('[engine] ...' logs).

moduleHooks.name: onEngineReady
moduleHooks.doc: main() finished setup, views may be created.

moduleHooks.name: onEngineEvent
moduleHooks.doc: Events (see events), payload JSON or empty; fromEngineThread false for events of other threads.

moduleHooks.name: onEngineFrame
moduleHooks.type: (viewId, pixels, width, height, x, y, w, h) => void
moduleHooks.doc: Frame in shared memory when the view canvas is not in the engine worker; answer with bl_frame_presented. Without the hook frames count as presented.

moduleHooks.name: onEngineNeedsFrame
moduleHooks.doc: Call bl_frame at the next requestAnimationFrame.

moduleHooks.name: engineDialog
moduleHooks.doc: SYNCHRONOUS on the main thread while the engine thread waits: type 0 alert -> 0, 1 confirm -> 0/1, 2 prompt -> malloc'ed UTF-8 pointer or 0, 3 beforeunload leave / 4 reload -> 1 continue.

moduleHooks.name: onEngineDownloadData
moduleHooks.doc: Data of a download between 'download-start' and 'download-done'.

moduleHooks.name: onEnginePrint
moduleHooks.doc: Finished PDF of bl_print or window.print().

moduleHooks.name: onEngineIcon
moduleHooks.doc: Favicon of the page (empty bytes = none).

moduleHooks.name: onEngineMedia
moduleHooks.doc: Commands for the host <video> of a player (media feature).

moduleHooks.name: onEngineMediaFetch
moduleHooks.doc: Results of bl_media_fetch: head, data, end or error.

moduleHooks.name: onEngineAudio
moduleHooks.type: (type, id, ring, capacityFrames, channels, sampleRate) => void
moduleHooks.doc: Web Audio output (audio feature): 'start' with a ring buffer in shared memory, 'stop', 'close' (the host frees ring with _free).

moduleHooks.name: blAlloc
moduleHooks.doc: malloc that throws RangeError when memory is full.

moduleHooks.name: blEngineWorker
moduleHooks.doc: Worker of the engine thread.

moduleHooks.name: blPresenterWorker
moduleHooks.doc: Worker the view canvases go to: postMessage({ blCanvas: offscreenCanvas, viewId }, [offscreenCanvas]).

moduleHooks.name: blWriteFiles
moduleHooks.doc: Writes host files into the engine file system in chunks.

moduleHooks.name: blClearHttpCache
moduleHooks.doc: Deletes the HTTP cache of the namespace.

moduleHooks.name: blClearBytecodeCache
moduleHooks.doc: Deletes the bytecode caches of the namespace.

moduleHooks.name: blShutdown
moduleHooks.doc: Closes all transport streams and terminates all engine threads; the module is unusable afterwards.

events.payload: {url, canGoBack, canGoForward, loading, history: {entries: [{url, title}], index} | null}
empty, or {errorPage: 'network' | 'certificate'} for an error page
{level, message, source, line}; level 0 log, 1 warning, 2 error, 3 debug, 4 info
{on}; on true asks the host to lock, answer bl_pointer_lock
{opener} (view id of the opener, 0 = none); the view id is the new view
{x, y, link, image, selection, editable, canGoBack, canGoForward, ...}
{x, y, width, height, selectedIndex, items: [{text, tooltip, enabled, label, selected} | {separator}]}; answer bl_popup_choose
{x, y, width, height, value}; answer bl_color_chosen
{x, y, width, height, type, value, min, max, step}; answer bl_datetime_chosen
{id, name, origin, payload (JSON string)}; answer bl_host_call_result
{id, title, body, icon, tag, lang, silent, persistent}; view 0 for service workers
{id, text, lang, voice, volume, rate, pitch}

features.name: audio
features.doc: Web Audio output through onEngineAudio. Off: no AudioContext.

features.name: media
features.doc: <video>/<audio> and MSE through a host <video> and the media service worker. Off: files and MSE do not load, canPlayType returns '' and MediaSource.isTypeSupported false; srcObject streams still play.

features.name: pip
features.doc: Picture-in-picture through the host <video>. Off: requestPictureInPicture missing.

features.name: capture
features.doc: getUserMedia/getDisplayMedia through the host. Off: they reject with NotAllowedError.

features.name: webrtc
features.doc: RTCPeerConnection through the host (bypasses the transport). Off: no RTCPeerConnection.

features.name: geolocation
features.doc: Geolocation through the host. Off: permission denied.

features.name: sensors
features.doc: deviceorientation/devicemotion through the host. Off: no events.

features.name: gamepad
features.doc: Gamepads through the host. Off: getGamepads() stays empty.

features.name: speech
features.doc: speechSynthesis and speech recognition through the host. Off: both APIs missing.

features.name: notifications
features.doc: Notifications through the host. Off: permission denied.

features.name: clipboard
features.doc: Copy in the page reaches the host clipboard ('clipboard' event). Off: the clipboard stays inside the engine.

env.name: BL_FEATURES
env.doc: Comma list of features (see features); unset = all, empty = none.

env.name: BL_STORAGE_NAMESPACE
env.doc: ^[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$: OPFS directory of /data and prefix of the cache names <ns>-http, <ns>-bytecode-<build id>. Invalid: memory only, no HTTP and no bytecode cache.

env.name: BL_OPFS
env.doc: 0: /data in memory only. The Cache API caches (BL_HTTP_CACHE, BL_BYTECODE_CACHE) are separate.

env.name: BL_ERROR_PAGE
env.doc: HTML template of the error page with {{lang}} {{kind}} {{title}} {{heading}} {{message}} {{code}} {{url}} {{retryLabel}}; [data-bl-retry] elements retry.

env.name: BL_EXTRA_CA
env.doc: Extra CA certificates (PEM) for TLS; written to a file and removed from the environment.

env.name: BL_KEEP_SESSION_COOKIES
env.doc: 1: session cookies survive a restart.

env.name: TZ
env.doc: Time zone of the pages.

env.name: BL_DEBUG
env.doc: Engine log with timestamps on stderr.

env.name: BL_GPU
env.doc: 0: Skia paints on the CPU.

env.name: BL_COMPOSITING
env.doc: 0: no layers and no compositor thread.

env.name: BL_HTTP_CACHE
env.doc: 0: no persistent HTTP cache.

env.name: BL_BYTECODE_CACHE
env.doc: 0: no persistent bytecode cache.

env.name: BL_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Seconds an entry into JS may block the engine before the watchdog terminates it, 0 = off.

env.name: BL_SAFEPOINT_GC
env.doc: GC at safe points in JS: 0 off, debug with output.

env.name: BL_TEST_HOOKS
env.doc: 1: bl_eval_script, bl_memory_report and bl_crash_for_testing work. Never with foreign pages in production.

env.name: BL_ASYNC_SCROLLING
env.doc: 0: scrolling on the engine thread.

env.name: BL_BUILD_ID
env.doc: Version of stored bytecode; empty disables the bytecode cache.

env.name: BL_MEMORY_RELEASE_MB
env.doc: malloc footprint from which caches are released at every 32 MB of growth, 0 = off.

env.name: BL_MEMORY_PRESSURE_MB
env.doc: malloc footprint from which 'memory-pressure' is reported.

env.name: BL_INDEXEDDB_QUOTA_MB
env.doc: IndexedDB limit per origin.

env.name: BL_DATABASE_MAX_MB
env.doc: Biggest SQLite file loaded into memory.

env.name: BL_FONTCONFIG_EARLY
env.doc: 0: fontconfig is set up on first use instead of in the background at start.

env.name: BL_SPARE_WORKERS
env.doc: Extra pthread workers loaded right after start.

env.name: BL_MALLOC_CACHE
env.doc: Size of the FastMalloc cache.

env.name: BL_LLINT_TUNING
env.doc: Tuning of the LLInt slow paths.

env.name: JSC_*
env.doc: JSC options, e.g. JSC_useLLIntICs=false.

env.name: FC_*
env.doc: fontconfig switches, e.g. FC_DEBUG.
